svg.title: The public API of Sparse Linear Algebra
svg.desc: The public API of the fcarouge namespace. The sparse_matrix class template stores the elements of its compile-time pattern, a sparse::pattern of strictly ascending row-major positions, constructed from a shape and positions or a predicate, or taken from the predefined patterns. The sparsity_pattern concept constrains the matrix. Free functions and operators operate on it, their result patterns computed by the pattern algebra variable templates. The _o literal marks a structural zero in a construction from rows, and a standard formatter specialization formats the matrix.
